system.description: Armor Class: 6 Hit Dice: 6(L) Move: 120' (40') Attacks: 1 gore/1 bite or 1 weapon Damage: 1d6/ 1d6 or by weapon type + 2 No. Appearing: 1d6(ld8) Save As: F6 Morale: 12 Treasure Type: C Intelligence: 5 Alignment: Chaotic XP Value: 275 Monster Type: Monster (Common). A minotaur is a large man-shaped creature with the head, hide and temperament of a bull. It is larger than human size (standing 7-9' tall) and eats humans. It will attack anything its size or smaller and will pursue as long as its prey is in sight.
